sol.label: Edit profile
sol.detail: At x671, y129 the menu places a check on Default and keeps the Middle click card fixed at y174.

sol.label: Outside the diagram
sol.detail: The light Back button hover fills marker 2 near x555, y230 and outlines the matching row. The MX Master 4 adds Button 0x01FF below marker 6's row.

sol.label: Gesture button tap
sol.detail: At 720 px wide the Win and Tab keycaps sit at x237 and x275, with an Edit button on the same row.

sol.label: Choose an action to assign now
sol.detail: In the desktop editor the category divider stays near x658 as Common, System and Edit replace the rows. The compact dialog keeps Reopen tab visible near y422.

sol.label: No matching actions
sol.detail: In the light dialog two recovery buttons sit side by side at y339, with an additional clear x near x670 in the search field.

sol.label: Save pointer speed action
sol.detail: The two numeric boxes line up at x586 and the orange save button spans x528 to x932. Current and Next press sit above it.

sol.label: Save shortcut
sol.detail: At 720 by 360, the Ctrl + Win + Alt + Shift + Space draft fits on one line and the save button stays inside the dialog at y299. The reopened editor shows K with a green Saved label. The three native tab cycles keep the tabs fixed at y204, and after restart K is still shown under Assigned now.

sol.label: Ignore accidental nudges
sol.detail: The active slider thumb sits around x575, and 50% of a notch is right aligned. With high-resolution scrolling off the saved threshold moves into the helper text.

sol.label: Gesture recognition off
sol.detail: Turning recognition off grays out the arrows near x260 and keeps the amber pencils at x904. The Tap row moves down about 53 px.

sol.label: Pick a window
sol.detail: The 6s countdown appears above the app chip and the + 6 seconds and Cancel buttons. Rename keeps the second card in place with the field beginning at x288. Native capture adds a python.exe chip and confirms it in the lower-right corner.

sol.label: Disconnected
sol.detail: The slashed mouse sits inside a 52 px tile near x256 and the Edit button mappings command sits directly below the card.

sol.label: 18 unnamed features
sol.detail: Amber hexadecimal IDs align at x249 and x594 above two rows of smaller chips. Copy device report and Copy unnamed IDs stay separately labeled.

sol.label: Applies after resume
sol.detail: The compact editor puts the note just left of Save shortcut at y314. On save, a green check appears under Buttons and the Back button row shows an M keycap. Native Retry restores the green Remapping resumed chip in both themes.

sol.label: Resume remapping
sol.detail: The native menu changes the second command label in place, and the Start with Windows check stays at about x28, y125.

terra.label: Buttons
terra.detail: The Edit profile selector sits at the upper right; the opened menu shows Default and Preview app side by side.

terra.label: Outside the diagram
terra.detail: MX Master 4 has six numbered markers and a separate Button 0x01FF row under Outside the diagram.

terra.label: Button mapping list
terra.detail: At 720 by 540, five full-width rows show Edit buttons and keycaps such as Ctrl W.

terra.label: Back button
terra.detail: The editor pairs a cropped Thumb buttons image with categories and a scrollable action list.

terra.label: No matching actions
terra.detail: The empty search shows Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut beneath a magnifying glass.

terra.label: Wheel mode button
terra.detail: Switch pointer speed opens two numeric DPI fields, two sliders, and a full-width Save pointer speed action.

terra.label: Keyboard shortcut
terra.detail: Recording changes the outlined panel to Press a key; a draft survives switching to Actions and is labeled Draft.

terra.label: Scroll
terra.detail: SmartShift is selected in an amber bordered card, with a 10 sensitivity and a 50% of a notch threshold.

terra.label: Gestures
terra.detail: Five directional rows pair orange arrow icons with action pills, and the threshold reads 60 counts.

terra.label: Profiles
terra.detail: The window picker shows a six-second countdown and later adds a python.exe chip to Preview app.

terra.label: Device
terra.detail: The device page displays Bluetooth, firmware MPM 12.01.B0006, a 50% battery bar and 1000 DPI.

terra.label: HID++ features
terra.detail: Eleven named entries appear in two columns above 18 unnamed hexadecimal chips and a copy button.

terra.label: Remapping paused
terra.detail: A red status pill and Resume button sit in the title bar; an error banner supplies Retry and tray instructions.

terra.label: Pause remapping
terra.detail: The native tray menu has Open mouse settings, Pause or Resume remapping, a checked Start with Windows, and Quit Mushak.

astra.label: Edit profile
astra.detail: The selector stays at the upper right. Its open menu puts Default with a check beside Preview app, above the five assignment cards.

astra.label: Outside the diagram
astra.detail: The MX Master 4 has six numbered markers, with a separate seventh card for Button 0x01FF. Hovering marker 2 outlines the matching Back button card in amber.

astra.label: Gesture button tap
astra.detail: The 720 by 540 layout uses five rows with labeled Edit buttons. Ctrl and W appear as separate keycaps next to Close tab.

astra.label: Choose an action to assign now
astra.detail: The category column stays left of a thin divider. System shows four commands while Edit shows six, with the editor's lower edge held steady.

astra.label: No matching actions
astra.detail: The empty search state centers a magnifier above Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut. Copy results show Ctrl and C in separate keycaps.

astra.label: Save pointer speed action
astra.detail: Two numeric DPI fields, 800 and 1600, sit beside aligned sliders. Current: 1000 DPI and Next press: 800 DPI appear above the full-width save button.

astra.label: Keyboard shortcut · Draft
astra.detail: Recording outlines the key card in amber. The M draft survives the tab switch, the 720 by 360 layout retains both footer buttons, and reopening K shows a green Saved state. Three native cycles keep the same editor position and dimensions.

astra.label: Ignore accidental nudges
astra.detail: The nudge value reads 50% of a notch at the right edge of its card. SmartShift has an amber radio border, and both toggle thumbs remain distinct in each theme.

astra.label: Minimum swipe distance
astra.detail: Five gesture rows pair amber direction icons with shortcut chips. The distance card says 60 counts and explains about 1.5 mm at 1000 DPI.

astra.label: Pick a window
astra.detail: The running capture replaces its button with + 6 seconds and Cancel. Renaming Design tools keeps the text field, Cancel and Save name on one row. A long profile name moves its reorder controls to a second row without overlap.

astra.label: Reported mouse features
astra.detail: The connected screen shows a half-filled green battery bar, a DPI slider at 1000 and a 29 detected disclosure. Disconnected and No device both offer Edit button mappings.

astra.label: HID++ features
astra.detail: Eleven named hexadecimal IDs form two aligned columns. Eighteen unnamed IDs wrap into two rows below a Copy unnamed IDs button.

astra.label: Remapping paused
astra.detail: The title bar retains a red paused badge after dismissing the conflict banner. The compact shortcut footer says Applies after resume beside Save shortcut.

astra.label: Start with Windows
astra.detail: A native light menu places a check left of Start with Windows and separators above Pause remapping and Quit Mushak.
